verdict.rationale: Termius's own docs say it ships a built-in Local terminal alongside its remote protocols, which is the capability this story needs. That is the only mention, though, so how far it goes is unproven. missing for 10: which platforms the Local terminal runs on (desktop vs. iOS/Android), confirmation that common UNIX tools (ls, grep, cat, tar, curl) are available locally, any detail on the local shell, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run local UNIX commands like ls, grep, cat, tar, and curl directly in the app

citations.quote: It includes a built-in Local terminal and supports SSH, Mosh, Telnet, Serial, and SFTP.
